_doc: GeoGuessr-style areas that group the admin-1 units of the region raster (data/world_regions.npz, Natural Earth admin-1) per country, as players name them (US census divisions, Brazilian macro-regions, Russian federal districts, ...).  Written by tools/make_areas.py (edit the groupings there, not here).  countries.<CC>: {source, areas: [{id, name (Ukrainian), en, regions: [ISO 3166-2 codes of the raster]}], hidden: [codes]}; every raster unit of a listed country is in exactly one area or in its hidden list (units the raster files under the country that do not belong to it: shown in no area and no region list of it), and at least half of a country's areas group two or more units (checked by test_regions_areas.py).  Countries not listed: engine/areas.py groups their units automatically into compass-named areas when they have at least 17 (AUTO_MIN_UNITS) units, otherwise they have no areas (the HUD lists their regions).  region_names: display names replacing the raster's.  unit_points: label points (lat, lng) of the raster units without a pixel (engine/areas.py puts them into the nearest automatic area).

US.source: US Census Bureau census regions and divisions (Alaska and Hawaii split from the Pacific division).

MX.source: Common five-way split of the 32 states (north / west-Bajio / centre / south-Gulf / Yucatan Peninsula), after the INEGI-style macro-regions used by GeoGuessr guides.

BR.source: IBGE macro-regions (Norte, Nordeste, Centro-Oeste, Sudeste, Sul).

AR.source: Geographic regions of Argentina (NOA, NEA, Cuyo, Pampas / Centro, Patagonia).

CL.source: Chile's natural macro-zones (Norte Grande, Norte Chico, Zona Central, Zona Sur, Zona Austral).

CO.source: Natural regions of Colombia (departments by their main region).

PE.source: Macro-regions of Peru (north / centre incl. Lima / south / Amazon).

EC.source: Natural regions of Ecuador (Costa, Sierra, Oriente, Galapagos).

BO.source: Bolivia's three physiographic zones (Altiplano, valleys, lowlands).

UY.source: Montevideo metro / coast / interior split common in guides.

GT.source: Regions of Guatemala grouped (centre / west highlands / north / east / Pacific coast).

RU.source: Federal districts of Russia. RU-RUS99, an unnamed raster sliver at 68.8N 67.3E (Yamal), counts in the Ural district.  Hidden: Crimea (UA-43, UA-40) is Ukraine; the Natural Earth raster files it under Russia, so it appears in no area and in no region list of Russia.

UA.source: Common macro-regions of Ukraine (west / north / centre / east / south).

FR.source: The 13 metropolitan regions of 2016 (from the departments of the raster); overseas departments are their own GeoGuessr countries.

ES.source: Autonomous communities of Spain (from the provinces of the raster).

PT.source: NUTS-2 regions of Portugal approximated by districts (Santarem counted in the Centre).

IT.source: The 20 regions of Italy (from the provinces of the raster).

GB.source: The four nations; England in four groups of ONS regions (North East + North West + Yorkshire and the Humber, East + West Midlands, London + South East + East of England, South West).

NO.source: The traditional regions (landsdeler) of Norway over the pre-2020 counties of the raster; Svalbard and Bouvet Island apart.

SE.source: The three lands of Sweden (Norrland, Svealand, Gotaland) over the counties.

FI.source: The provinces of Finland 1997-2009 (Southern, Western, Eastern, Oulu, Lapland) over the regions.

PL.source: Macro-regions of Poland (NUTS-1, 2018) over the voivodeships.

DE.source: German states grouped as north / east / west / south (common GeoGuessr split).

HU.source: Regions of Hungary (NUTS-2) over the counties and the cities with county rights of the raster.

HR.source: Croatia: Adriatic, Zagreb and the north, Central Croatia, Slavonia. HR-11 (Pozega-Slavonia) may be missing from the raster.

GR.source: Greece's 13 regions grouped as north (Macedonia, Thrace, Epirus) / centre (Thessaly, Central Greece, Attica) / Peloponnese and west / islands.

TR.source: The seven geographical regions of Turkey (1941 Geography Congress) over the provinces (plate codes).

JP.source: The traditional regions of Japan (Okinawa apart from Kyushu).

KR.source: Traditional provinces of South Korea with their metropolitan cities.

TW.source: Taiwan's north / centre / south / east and the outlying islands.

IN.source: Zonal councils of India (States Reorganisation Act 1956), Andaman, Nicobar and Lakshadweep with the south.

PH.source: The island groups of the Philippines, Luzon in north / centre-south, Bicol and MIMAROPA.

TH.source: The six geographic regions of Thailand (National Research Council 1977).

VN.source: Vietnam's three parts (North, Centre incl. the Central Highlands, South).

KH.source: The four natural regions of Cambodia with Phnom Penh in the plain. KH-5 ('Kam') is Kampong Speu in the raster.

MY.source: Peninsular Malaysia (north / east coast / centre-south) and East Malaysia.

LK.source: Provinces of Sri Lanka over the districts.

NP.source: Nepal's development regions over the former zones.

MN.source: The regions of Mongolia (Western, Khangai, Central, Eastern, Ulaanbaatar).

KZ.source: Kazakhstan's west / north / centre / east / south.

NZ.source: North Island / South Island; Chatham and the subantarctic islands apart.

NG.source: The six geopolitical zones of Nigeria.

ME.source: Statistical regions of Montenegro (Monstat: Coastal, Central, Northern) over the 21 municipalities of the raster.

DO.source: Development regions of the Dominican Republic (Decree 710-04) grouped by macro-region: Cibao (Norte, Sur, Nordeste, Noroeste); the south-west (Valdesia, El Valle, Enriquillo); Ozama (Santo Domingo with the Distrito Nacional) apart from the east (Higuamo, Yuma).

VE.source: Administrative regions of Venezuela (CORDIPLAN regionalisation: Capital, Central, Centro-Occidental, Zulia, Andes, Llanos, Nor-Oriental, Insular, Guayana). VE-VEN99 is Isla de Aves (Federal Dependencies).

SI.source: The 12 statistical regions of Slovenia (Natural Earth admin-1 'region', pre-2015 names: Spodnjeposavska = Posavska, Notranjsko-kraska = Primorsko-notranjska) over the municipalities.

LV.source: The five planning regions of Latvia (Natural Earth admin-1 'region') over the 2009-2021 municipalities and republican cities.

MK.source: The eight statistical regions of North Macedonia (Natural Earth admin-1 'region'; 'Greater Skopje' and 'Skopje' together are the Skopje region; units without the attribute assigned from the State Statistical Office list).

UG.source: The four regions of Uganda (Natural Earth admin-1 'region') over the districts.

BT.source: Western / Central / Eastern / Southern Bhutan (Natural Earth admin-1 'region') over the 20 dzongkhags.

HK.source: Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories (Natural Earth admin-1 'region') over the 18 districts.

XK.source: The seven districts of Kosovo (Natural Earth admin-1 'region') over the municipalities.

CN.source: The traditional six regions of China (Natural Earth admin-1 'region'; Fujian with East China, the Paracel Islands with South Central China as administered from Hainan).
